title: Juicy Flaky Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A fresh and flaky post-workout Malaysian dish featuring cranberry and sous-vide cooking, friendly to low-glycemic diets
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 140 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, lime juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in the sous-vide machine for 1 hour
Meanwhile, heat the cranberry sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat
Once the chicken is cooked, brush with the heated cranberry sauce
Serve the chicken satay hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving
